component.name: VST Environment
component.summary: Windows audio plugins in Linux DAWs, vendor managers included

description.p: A managed environment for Windows audio plugins on Linux. It provisions its own Wine, installs each vendor's manager application (Native Access, IK Product Manager, Steinberg Download Assistant) and the products it delivers, applies every fix those need under Wine (each one works around a decision the vendor made, not something Wine got wrong, and the app says which), and exposes the result to Linux DAWs as ordinary VST2, VST3 and CLAP plugins through yabridge — without the user ever dealing with Wine. Installed programs appear in the desktop's application menu.

Vendor support lives in modules: Native Instruments, IK Multimedia and Steinberg are built in, and a separate package can add another vendor. Vendor managers are not included: download them from the vendor (the app links to the page) and choose the file in the app. A portable Wine build is downloaded on first run.

Tested: Native Access with Kontakt 8, the IK Product Manager, and the Steinberg Download Assistant, Activation Manager and Library Manager with HALion Sonic 7, each signing in, installing products and running the plugins in a Linux DAW; FabFilter's Total Bundle, Soundtoys 5.5 with its iLok licensing, Valhalla DSP, Xfer Records' Serum 2, iZotope's Ozone 9 and Arturia's Analog Lab install as plain Windows programs and work unchanged; Spitfire Audio's app (JUCE 8) draws with the app's patched DirectComposition and vblank fixes.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Native Instruments GmbH, IK Multimedia Production srl or Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH.
